question.problem: Write the following series in sigma notation: $-5+25-125+625-⋯.$
question.worked_solution:
The first term is ${a}_{1}=-5$ and the second term is ${a}_{2}=25.$ Using these two terms, we compute the common ratio:

$$
r=\frac{{a}_{2}}{{a}_{1}}=\frac{25}{-5}=-5
$$

Therefore, the general term can be expressed as

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}{(r)}^{n-1} \\  & =-5{(-5)}^{n-1} \\  & =-5{(-5)}^{-1}{(-5)}^{n} \\  & =-5(-\frac{1}{5}){(-5)}^{n} \\  & ={(-5)}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, the infinite geometric series can be written in sigma notation as

$$
\begin{aligned}-5+25-125+625-⋯ & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{(-5)}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$
